teams.detail: Dropped Wednesday's series finale 2-0 to Miami — Kyle Stowers homered and Tyler Phillips held Seattle to four hits over five innings — falling to 47-46 but still atop the AL West. Back in action Friday at Miami.

Opened Vegas Summer League today vs. Philadelphia at Cox Pavilion (5:30 PM ET tip); Detroit trailed 25-30 after the first quarter as No. 17 overall pick Ebuka Okorie made his pro debut. Final score wasn't available as of this brief. Next: vs. Cleveland Sunday 7/12.

Two ownership groups have emerged as frontrunners to buy the team — one with Celtics minority owner Aditya Mittal and former Celtics governor Wyc Grousbeck, the other led by 49ers investor Vinod Khosla — with the sale expected to fetch $8-10B+. Training camp opens July 24 in Renton with public practices starting July 25; the 2026 draft class is fully signed after Jadarian Price's deal, and ESPN ranked Seattle's roster No. 3 overall league-wide.

UW is in the running for a cornerback and a pair of offensive linemen and landed a commitment from Colorado lineman Reis Russell. RB Jordan Washington is still targeting a late-July return from a spring injury as Jedd Fisch enters year three at the helm.

F Hannes Steinbach went 14th overall to the Hornets in June, the 4th-highest German draft pick in NBA history. Danny Sprinkle continues rebuilding through the portal after losing Zoom Diallo; it's the dead of summer for the program with most activity centered on recruiting.

headlines.headline: NBA Summer League tips off in Vegas as the Warriors emerge as frontrunners for LeBron James
headlines.detail: The 21st annual NBA Summer League opened today in Las Vegas with seven games across Prime, ESPN and ESPN2, an 11-day, 76-game showcase running through a July 19 championship game. Off the court, LeBron James — who told the Lakers he won't return for 2026-27 — is drawing pursuit from the Golden State Warriors as he chases a 24th NBA season.

headlines.headline: Washington to retire John Riggins' No. 44 in Week 9 as training camps loom league-wide
headlines.detail: Washington announced it will retire Hall of Fame running back John Riggins' No. 44 during its Week 9 game against the Rams. Elsewhere, Cardinals QB Jacoby Brissett posted himself working out with Arizona teammates amid a contract dispute, signaling he intends to be ready for camp.

headlines.headline: Deion Sanders reshapes Colorado's roster through the portal after a 3-9 season, headlined by WR DeAndre Moore Jr.
headlines.detail: Fresh off a 3-9 finish, Colorado head coach Deion Sanders returned to the transfer portal to reload the Buffaloes' roster, with former Texas wide receiver DeAndre Moore Jr. rated the class' biggest addition. Nationally, LSU built the portal cycle's top-rated class around QB Sam Leavitt and USC transfer Husan Longstreet.

headlines.headline: Duke enters 2026-27 as a preseason favorite as the first live recruiting period opens
headlines.detail: Analysts remain high on Duke heading into 2026-27 after an Elite Eight loss to UConn, with the Blue Devils returning three starters and adding transfer guard John Blackwell from Wisconsin. The first live recruiting evaluation period opened today, ahead of the Nike Peach Jam July 16-19.
